weather.note: ★ **今天（10/12 週一）是本週天氣最穩的一天：各地晴到多雲、水氣偏少。**依中央氣象署一週預報（經 NOWnews／壹蘋彙整）：**北部與東部高溫 29–31 度、中南部 32–33 度、南部近山區與內陸可到 34–35 度；清晨各地低溫約 20–25 度。**　★ **你在台南，白天抓 32–33 度、早晚 23 度上下**，日夜溫差約 9–10 度 —— 清晨騎車會冷、中午走在校園會熱，**開學第一天建議薄外套＋短袖，別只憑出門當下的體感決定穿什麼**。　★ 本週走勢（這段比今天的數字更有用）：**10/13（二）同樣晴朗偏乾、高溫約 30 度；10/14–15（三、四）東北季風增強，大台北與東半部轉雨、清晨低溫掉到 21–24 度，是本週最明顯的變天點；10/16–17（五、六）季風減弱轉東風，氣溫回升、西半部 31–34 度局部 35 度。**　★ 一個要先放進腦袋的事：**菲律賓東方到關島附近有低壓區，氣象署說週末可能發展熱帶擾動，但還不確定會不會成颱。**距離 10/21 期中考只有 9 天，**如果週末真的有颱風，受影響的是 10/19 之後的複習節奏，不是考試本身** —— 現在不用擔心，但排複習時段時把「週末可能不能出門」當成變數。　★ 本欄未直接接氣象署 API，數字來自一週預報彙整，出門前請再看一次即時預報。

items.detail: ★ 事實先講清楚：Moodle 票選「調課時間調查」的關閉時間是 **2026/10/11（日）23:59**，現在已經過了。**不論昨天有沒有投，票選都已經結束，這件事不能補。**　★ **今天的正確動作不是懊悔，是取得結果。**調課決定的是「1151_程序控制」這門課的補課或改課落在哪一個時段，而那個時段會固定佔住你整學期的每週行程。**你現在不知道結果，就等於有一塊每週固定的時間缺口沒有被填進課表。**　★ 怎麼確認（照順序，今天之內解決）：①先自己登入成大數位學習平臺（moodle.ncku.edu.tw）→ 課程「1151_程序控制」→ 看票選活動頁面或公佈欄**有沒有公布結果**（Moodle 票選關閉後常會直接顯示統計）；②沒公布就**今天上課問同班同學**，這是最快的方法；③都問不到就寄一封短信給助教或任課老師，問「調課時段最後確定是哪一個時段」。　★ **確認到之後立刻做兩件事**：把那個時段加進 Notion／課表，並**檢查它有沒有和 10/21（三）19:00–21:00 的熱力學期中考衝突** —— 如果調課剛好落在週三晚上，你會同時有考試和補課，那就必須今天就跟老師請假或協調，而不是考試當週才發現。　★ 學到的那一課（給下一次）：那兩封信的標題寫「投票調課時間調查**已關閉**」，看起來像「已經結束」，實際上指的是「這個活動的關閉時間點」，底下 `[1 day(s) to go]` 才是真相。**Moodle 的提醒信標題一律要看底下的 `to go` 行，不要看標題的動詞。**

items.en: Riyadh's main airport is attacked on two consecutive days, and Seoul raises its travel alert for all of Saudi Arabia
items.zh: 沙烏地利雅德國際機場連兩天遇襲 —— 首日飛彈攻擊 12 死，隔日再傳爆炸多人受傷，南韓將全境旅遊警示升至第 3 級
items.summary: A missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh killed twelve people, the deadliest strike on Saudi soil in more than a decade, and the airport was attacked again the following day with several injuries reported. The Houthis have since threatened Saudi airspace, and South Korea's foreign ministry raised its travel alert for the whole of Saudi Arabia to Level 3, advising departure. Reporting says President Donald Trump is weighing whether to join the fight. For energy markets the relevant detail is that Gulf aviation and export infrastructure is now being hit directly rather than only threatened.

items.en: Trump announces a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire that Kyiv says it had not agreed to
items.zh: 川普宣布俄烏達成「能源停火」，澤倫斯基說他是從公告才知道、且攻擊仍在持續
items.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to stop attacking each other's energy facilities. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy responded that this was the first he had heard of it, that Ukraine would agree only if Russia stopped first, and that attacks were continuing. Zelenskyy had separately offered to halt strikes on Russian refineries in exchange for Moscow sparing Ukraine's power grid. Ukraine also struck another major Russian technology site. The gap between the announcement and Kyiv's account is the story, because a ceasefire one party has not accepted is not a ceasefire.

items.en: A year after the US-brokered Gaza ceasefire, reporting says progress has stalled
items.zh: 美國斡旋的加薩停火屆滿一年，報導指後續進展停滯
items.summary: Coverage marking one year since the United States brokered a Gaza ceasefire describes progress as stalled, with the framework still in place but the political steps that were supposed to follow largely unrealised. Anniversary reporting of this kind is useful mainly as a checkpoint rather than as news, because it measures what did not happen against what was announced. The practical implication is that the humanitarian and reconstruction questions remain open going into a second year, and that regional escalation elsewhere in the Gulf is now competing for the same diplomatic attention.

items.en: The United States posts its largest annual budget deficit since the pandemic, with interest costs above 1.1 trillion dollars
items.zh: 美國年度財政赤字創新冠以來最大，光利息支出就超過 1.1 兆美元
items.summary: The federal government posted its largest annual budget deficit since the COVID period, with interest payments exceeding 1.1 trillion dollars for the year. Separately the Federal Reserve reported that median household net worth rose two percent between 2022 and 2025, with households headed by someone seventy-five or older recording the highest median at 504,000 dollars. Reporting also noted the US trade deficit has returned to pre-tariff levels. Interest costs above a trillion dollars matter for every risk asset, because they set the floor under long-dated Treasury yields.

items.en: A Russian plague researcher dies of pneumonia and the pathogen is still undisclosed a week later
items.zh: 俄國鼠疫研究人員死於肺炎，一週後病原仍未公布，WHO 表示無法確認死因
items.summary: A Russian researcher who worked on plague died of pneumonia, and a week later the authorities had still not disclosed which pathogen was involved. The World Health Organization said it was unsure what caused the death. The information gap rather than the case itself is what matters, because laboratory-linked respiratory deaths with undisclosed agents are exactly the scenario surveillance systems are designed to resolve quickly. This also connects directly to Taiwan's market: suspected Siberian plague cases drove three nonwoven-fabric stocks to their daily limit on October 8.

items.en: Tencent reportedly leases about 100,000 AI chips from Oracle for roughly 7 billion dollars over five years
items.zh: 騰訊傳向 Oracle 租用約 10 萬顆 AI 晶片、五年約 70 億美元，單價比 H100 標準租金低約 43%
items.summary: Tencent reportedly agreed to lease about one hundred thousand AI chips from Oracle for roughly seven billion dollars over five years. The implied hourly cost is about forty-three percent below standard H100 rental rates, which suggests Hopper-class hardware rather than the newest parts. The chips are not named. The reason this is more than a procurement story is that leasing offshore compute may give Chinese firms effective access to export-controlled hardware without importing it, which is a gap current rules were not written for. Oracle is in your watchlist under AI cloud.

items.en: OpenAI and Synopsys are building a model that can drive EDA tools for autonomous chip design
items.zh: OpenAI 與 Synopsys 合作開發「GPT-Synopsys」，讓模型直接操作 EDA 工具做自動化晶片設計
items.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys are building a specialised model, referred to as GPT-Synopsys, able to operate Synopsys electronic design automation tools for autonomous chip design. Reporting suggests it may feed into successors of OpenAI's Jalapeño inference ASIC, and that the partnership structure could sidestep intellectual-property hurdles around tool usage. For a chemical engineering reader the interesting part is downstream: faster design iteration does not relieve the physical bottlenecks, which remain advanced packaging capacity, thermal budget and power delivery, all of which are materials and process problems rather than software ones.

items.en: Microsoft's chief executive says AI needs an emergency brake that humans control
items.zh: 微軟執行長 Nadella 說 AI 需要一個「由人類控制的緊急煞車」；OpenAI 則證實開除三名研究員
items.summary: Microsoft chief executive Satya Nadella said AI systems need an emergency brake that humans control, in remarks reported by CNBC and TechCrunch. Separately OpenAI said it dismissed three researchers for violating policies on sensitive information rather than for raising safety concerns, a distinction the company was explicit about. A study reported the same week found that AI coding tools generate more code but not more shipped software, because human review becomes the bottleneck. The three items describe the same shift: the constraint on AI deployment is now oversight capacity, not model capability.

items.en: The Uni-President Lions level the CPBL challenge series, forcing a decisive Game 4 in Taichung tonight
items.zh: 統一獅昨晚扳平中職季後挑戰賽，今晚 10/12 洲際生死戰 G4 —— 結果直接決定 10/21 你考試那晚台南塞不塞車
items.summary: The Uni-President Lions beat the CTBC Brothers in Game 3 at Taichung Intercontinental Stadium on Sunday October 11 to level the CPBL postseason challenge series, forcing a decisive Game 4 at the same venue tonight. The winner meets the Wei Chuan Dragons in a best-of-seven Taiwan Series opening October 17 at the Taipei Dome. Games 3 and 4 of that series fall on October 20 and 21 and would be played in Tainan if the Lions advance, with Game 4 starting at 18:35 on the evening of a 19:00 exam in Tainan.

items.en: Cleveland shuts out the White Sox 2-0 in a winner-take-all Game 5 and advances to the ALCS
items.zh: 守護者分區決勝第 5 戰 2:0 完封白襪、以 3 勝 2 敗晉級美聯冠軍賽，今晚對光芒開打 G1
items.summary: The Cleveland Guardians beat the Chicago White Sox two to nil in the deciding Game 5 of their all-American League Central Division Series on October 10, taking the series three games to two and denying Chicago its first Championship Series appearance since the 2005 World Series. Cleveland now opens the American League Championship Series against the Tampa Bay Rays at 8 p.m. Eastern on Monday October 12 in Tampa Bay, which is Tuesday morning Taipei time. Forecast models going in favoured the Rays at about seventy percent.

items.en: The National League Championship Series opens in Milwaukee with the Brewers hosting the Dodgers
items.zh: 國聯冠軍賽釀酒人主場開打對道奇 —— G1 台北時間今天早上 8 點，賽前預測釀酒人勝率約 57%
items.summary: Game 1 of the National League Championship Series was scheduled for 8 p.m. Eastern on Sunday October 11 at Milwaukee, which is 8 a.m. Taipei time on Monday, with Game 2 following at the same venue. The Milwaukee Brewers hold home advantage and forecast models gave them about fifty-seven percent, a narrower edge than the American League matchup. Games 3 through 5 move to Los Angeles from October 14 before the series returns to Milwaukee for Games 6 and 7 if required. The World Series would begin in late October.

items.en: Gallup finds AI use is now routine for college students even where campuses restrict it
items.zh: Gallup 調查：AI 已是大學生的日常工具，即使校方設限也一樣 —— 學生使用率遠高於教師
items.summary: A Gallup poll finds that artificial intelligence use has become routine for college students despite campus limits on it, with adoption running well ahead of institutional policy. Parallel survey work reported the same month puts student AI use at around eighty-eight percent while faculty adoption lags substantially. The practical reading for a student is not permission but positioning: when a tool is near-universal among peers, the differentiator stops being access and becomes judgement about when not to use it, particularly in assessed work where the verification burden falls back on you.

items.en: EDUCAUSE 2026 concludes that universities should teach baseline AI skills to everyone
items.zh: EDUCAUSE 2026 年會結論：大學應該把「基本 AI 技能」當成全校共同必修，而不是資工系的事
items.summary: At the EDUCAUSE 2026 conference, speakers argued that higher education should teach baseline AI skills across the whole institution rather than confining them to computing programmes. An accompanying EDUCAUSE research report on the impact of AI on work in higher education documents how staff roles are already changing. For an engineering student the concrete implication is that AI literacy is moving from an optional advantage to an assumed baseline, in the same way spreadsheet and basic programming competence did, and that it will increasingly be assessed implicitly rather than taught explicitly.

items.en: A new survey finds more parents are seeking professional mental health support for their students
items.zh: World Mental Health Day 前後調查：愈來愈多家長主動為就學子女尋求專業心理支持
items.summary: A survey released around World Mental Health Day on October 10 reports that a growing share of parents are seeking professional mental health support for their school-age and college-age children, rather than treating difficulties as something to manage privately. The European Commission marked the same day with a campaign emphasising talking and listening. The useful framing is that help-seeking itself is rising, which changes what the numbers mean: higher reported rates of support can indicate reduced stigma rather than worsening underlying mental health, and the two are easy to confuse.

items.en: Anthropic reportedly brokered a compute deal with SpaceX worth about 1.25 billion dollars a month
items.zh: 華爾街日報：Anthropic 共同創辦人 Tom Brown 談成每月約 12.5 億美元的 SpaceX 算力合約；另指控中國 AI 公司偷用 Claude 訓練模型
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown brokered a SpaceX compute deal worth roughly 1.25 billion dollars per month, and that Brown used Republican contacts to resolve a June standoff over model safety. Separately Anthropic has accused Chinese AI firms of covertly using Claude to train their own models, and Bloomberg reported that Anthropic books gross sales through cloud partners while OpenAI records only its net share, which makes headline revenue figures between the two not directly comparable. SpaceX sits in your watchlist under space and satellites.

items.en: Nvidia is in talks over Reflection AI and commits a billion dollars to US super-intelligence research
items.zh: Nvidia 傳洽購或加碼投資開源權重新創 Reflection AI，並承諾五年 10 億美元投入量子、醫療與能源的「超智慧」研究
items.summary: The Financial Times reported that Nvidia is in talks to acquire or further invest in Reflection AI, a United States open-weights startup, with the deal possibly structured as an acquihire to limit antitrust scrutiny. Separately Nvidia committed one billion dollars over five years to United States super-intelligence research spanning quantum computing, healthcare and energy. Both items point the same way: Nvidia is converting hardware margin into control of the surrounding research and talent layer, which matters for the five pure-play quantum names in your watchlist more than any company roadmap does.
items.source: Financial Times（經 Rio Rundown AI News）

items.en: Google collapses its enterprise AI products into a single Gemini Agent, and Mistral readies an open-weight trillion-parameter model
items.zh: Google 在 Gemini at Work 2026 把企業 AI 收斂成單一「Gemini Agent」；Mistral Large 4 將在 10 月底前釋出權重
items.summary: At Gemini at Work 2026 Google consolidated its enterprise AI offerings into a single Gemini Agent delivered through Google Cloud, replacing a scattered set of product surfaces. Separately Mistral's trillion-parameter open-weight model, Mistral Large 4, reportedly ranks as the strongest model outside the United States and China, scoring thirty-eight on Artificial Analysis's intelligence index and performing particularly well on cybersecurity tasks, with weights expected before the end of October. Alphabet is in your watchlist under core technology, and the consolidation is a distribution move rather than a capability one.

items.en: Fujii Kaze plays Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31, the only Taiwan date on your list inside a month
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 10/31 高雄國家體育場 —— 清單 16 組歌手裡，19 天內唯一有台灣場的一位
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour stops at Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31, 2026, a date added after the original routing. It is nineteen days away and is the only Taiwan show by anyone on your tracking list inside the next month. The tour continues at Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka on November 14 and 15, Kyocera Dome Osaka on December 10 and 12 to 13, Tokyo Dome on December 19 and 20, and Bangkok on December 26, with Seoul in January 2027. The Hong Kong show was cancelled.

items.en: YOASOBI's Asia dome and stadium tour reaches the Taipei Dome on January 9 and 10, 2027
items.zh: YOASOBI 亞洲十城巨蛋巡迴台北站確定：2027/1/9、1/10 台北大巨蛋兩場；新加坡國家體育場 2/20
items.summary: YOASOBI's ten-city Asian dome and stadium tour, billed as the first of that scale by a Japanese act, has confirmed Taipei Dome on January 9 and 10, 2027, and Singapore's National Stadium on February 20, 2027. Seoul, Hong Kong and one further overseas city remain to be announced. The Japan leg runs from Kyocera Dome Osaka in late October through Tokyo Dome in early December. Because Taipei Dome shows at this scale typically open ballots two to three months ahead, the practical window for Taiwanese fans is around now through November.

items.en: LiSA releases the best-of album LiSA BEST -LOUD- on December 2, with pre-orders already open
items.zh: LiSA 精選輯《LiSA BEST -LOUD-》12/2 發行、多版本預購開跑；她今年的台北與香港場都已結束
items.summary: LiSA releases a best-of album titled LiSA BEST -LOUD- on December 2, 2026, in several editions with pre-orders already open. Her 2026 Asian run under the LiVE is Smile Always 15 banner has already passed through Taipei Arena on June 19 and 20 and AsiaWorld-Arena Hong Kong on July 18, with the European and United Kingdom leg finishing in late September. So the album rather than a show is the thing to act on this quarter, and limited editions of Japanese best-of sets usually sell out before release rather than after.

items.en: The 2026 Asia touring window has closed for most of the list, leaving a gap until early 2027
items.zh: 清單盤點：King Gnu、Official髭男dism、back number、LiSA 的 2026 亞洲場全部結束 —— 下一個台港窗口要等 10/31 藤井風與 2027/1 YOASOBI
items.summary: Taking stock of the tracking list, the 2026 Asian legs are now finished for King Gnu, who played Hong Kong in late May and Taipei Arena in early June, Official HIGE DANdism, who played Taipei Arena in late August, back number, who closed an Asian leg at AsiaWorld-Expo Hong Kong on September 26 and 27, and LiSA. Mrs. GREEN APPLE's current run remains a Japan-only fan-club tour with no overseas dates listed. That leaves exactly two regional dates ahead: Kaohsiung on October 31 and Taipei Dome in January.

market.note: ★ 開盤前要分清楚的三條線：　①【台股：10/08 的回檔要放回週線看，不要用它預測今天】加權指數收 49,313.44、跌 492.93 點（約 -0.99%），成交值約 8,696.96 億元（連三天萎縮）；電子 -1.07%、金融 -1.68%（當天最弱）、玻璃 -2.5% 以上，水泥與紡織收漲。**但同一週累計仍上漲 837.7 點、週線連四紅** —— 10/08 是五萬點叩關四天失敗後的單日回檔，不是趨勢反轉。0050 收 114.95（-0.95%）、0056 收 58.30（-0.26%）。權值股普遍下挫（台積電跌 35 元收 2,550 元、聯發科下挫 145 元、台達電與鴻海收跌），但清單內**日月光投控 +12 元、台光電 +50 元、南亞科 +18 元**逆勢收紅 —— 封測、CCL、記憶體三個中段環節全部抗跌，**資金沒有離開 AI 基建，只是從最大權值往中段零組件移動。**　★ **重要提醒：連休三天後的開盤前五分鐘，價格通常不是當天的真實水準。**情緒在三天裡累積、法人的調整在同一瞬間釋放，**不要用開盤價做任何判斷，至少看到 9:30。**　②【清單內兩個警訊，性質完全不同】**川湖（2059）10/08 跌停收 10,615 元**，連兩個交易日進跌幅榜，同族群穎崴、松川精密、巨鎧精密也在回檔，**更像機構件／精密機械的族群性修正**；從參考價 14,180 元算起波段回落約 -25%。**奇鋐（3017）跌 105 元（依參考價約 -3.07%，示意），原因是法務部調查局搜索** —— 幅度沒到 5%，但這是法律與公司治理事件，時間軸數週到數月、股價影響常分兩段。　③【美股：指數反彈是結果，SpaceX 才是事件】道瓊 51,654.95（+423.31、+0.83%）、S&P 500 7,811.54（+46.18、+0.59%）、那斯達克綜合 27,366.17（+172.83、+0.64%）、QQQ 751.27（+0.49%）。**週線：道瓊 +1.15%、S&P 500 +0.95%、那斯達克 +0.19%、Russell 2000 -0.91%（唯一收黑）。**殖利率全面小升：2 年 4.795%、10 年 5.248%、30 年 5.608%。　★ 本週（10/12 起）三個行事曆事件：**①銀行財報從 10/13（二）開始，那是財報季真正的開場 ②CPI 報告 ③今晚美股開盤是對 SpaceX 頻譜案的第二輪定價 —— 單日跌 10% 之後的第一個交易日，通常是籌碼而不是基本面在決定價格。**

movers.reason: **10/09 漲幅最大的兩檔都在醫療，醫療也是當日第二強的類股（+1.48%）。**　★ **Humana（HUM）+12.18%**：美國 CMS 恢復其一份主要 Medicare Advantage 合約的 4 星評等（另有報導指 2027 年星等改善）。星等直接決定給付加成，**這是現金流層級的消息，不是情緒。**　★ **Moderna（MRNA）+9.22%**：重新納入那斯達克 100 指數。**注意這是指數成分調整帶來的被動買盤，不是臨床或營收利多** —— 這類漲幅在調整生效後常回吐，和 Humana 的性質完全不同。　★ 和你清單的連結：「醫療」分類有 LLY、NVO、AMGN，「防禦型」有 JNJ、PG、KO。10/09 醫療 +1.48%、不動產 +1.85% 同時走強，**而殖利率當天其實是上升的** —— 這和「殖利率上升壓抑防禦股」的教科書邏輯相反，說明當週的防禦股走勢是個股消息驅動、不是利率驅動。**別把單週的類股輪動當成規律。**　★ 誠實說明：這兩檔**仍未取得確認收盤價**。既然電信三雄的收盤比盤中更深，這兩檔也可能有落差。
